sections.description: Replaces the default WordPress dashboard with a branded Group6 client portal — SEO metrics, reviews, service CTAs, and how-to guides.
sections.changelog:
In progress (beta)

  • Added an in-plugin Changelog viewer under Settings → Plugin, so this history is readable without leaving wp-admin
  • Contact form now logs the reason when Zendesk ticket creation fails, instead of silently falling back to email with no trace of why
  • Fixed the contact form always falling back to email instead of opening a Zendesk ticket -- a required Zendesk field ('What is your issue?') was never populated, causing every submission to fail validation
  • Rebuilt the dashboard's Subject dropdown to exactly mirror Zendesk's 'What is your issue?' options, so every topic maps to the correct Zendesk category instead of an approximate guess

v0.3.14

  • Fixed a fatal error caused by a duplicate plugin folder (e.g. from GitHub's 'Download ZIP' button) loading alongside the real installation; now guarded against and flagged with a clear admin notice instead
  • Support Hours: removed the percentage-remaining bar, since 'Total Hours Purchased' is a cumulative lifetime counter in Airtable that never resets on repurchase, making the percentage misleading after buying a new hour bucket
  • Support Hours color coding (and the purchase-more prompt) now uses an absolute-hours threshold instead of that percentage: 2 hours or less is red, 3 hours or less is orange, both show a prompt to purchase more
  • Support Hours settings card now hides its fields and dims to match a disabled widget when the feature is toggled off
  • Minor copy and spacing polish on the Support Hours sidebar CTA

v0.3.13

  • Support Hours meter — new dashboard sidebar widget showing a client's remaining support-hour balance, pulled live from Airtable
  • Color-coded horizontal bar (green/amber/red) with percentage remaining and a bold 'You have X hours left' readout
  • Shows a 'No active support plan' message when a client's plan is inactive, and an over-allocated state when hours go negative
  • Purchase-more CTA (email link) appears automatically once hours run critically low
  • New Support Hours card in settings: paste an Airtable Personal Access Token and a record URL/ID to connect a client's row, with cache status, manual refresh, and validation messaging
  • Sidebar now also appears when only Support Hours is configured, not just when tracking scripts are set
  • Fixed a missing 'refresh-cw' icon that left the Google Reviews refresh button blank
  • Fixed pressing Enter in a settings field sometimes triggering the wrong button (a 'Refresh Data' action instead of Save Settings)

v0.3.12

  • Drag-and-drop reordering added to the How-To Guides, Grow Your Business (Services), and Google My Business Locations/Competitors repeaters in settings
  • Fixed a bug where the Services 'Mark as Popular' flag could become misattributed to the wrong service after reordering

v0.3.11

  • Widgets tab redesign: sticky sidebar lists every widget with its enable/disable toggle; clicking a row scrolls to that widget's settings card
  • All widget settings cards are now full width for a cleaner, less cluttered layout
  • Disabled widgets are now dimmed (50% opacity) so it is clear at a glance they are off, instead of looking active with just the settings hidden
  • Added the missing Featured Video play icon in both settings and the dashboard

v0.3.10

  • Google My Business integration via Places API (New) — live rating, review count, and 3 most-recent reviews fetched automatically every 48 hours
  • Multi-location support — add multiple Place IDs and show stats combined (weighted average) or per-location
  • Competitor comparison table (How You Compare) shows client vs competitors with gap indicators and Google Maps links
  • Dynamic CTA automatically highlights the largest review gap; override with custom text in settings
  • Reviews widget redesign: stats, compare box, then 3 latest reviews always combined from all locations
  • Location labels styled as proper section headers with separator rules

v0.3.9

  • Login Screen Customizer — branded split-screen login layout with logo, hero image, colors, and custom error message
  • Login settings: toggle show/hide fields, WordPress media library picker for images
  • Disable Attachment Pages developer tool
  • CSS variable support in color fields

v0.3.7

  • Google Analytics 4 tracking script support added
  • Dashboard sidebar hidden when no tracking scripts are configured

v0.3.6

  • Responsive CSS fixes — widget grid uses intrinsic sizing (no media queries), header and card side padding reduced to 24px on mobile
  • Dashboard subtitle copy updated

v0.3.5

  • Client dashboard sidebar showing active tracking script indicators with hover tooltip
  • Settings redesign — Dashboard and Widgets tabs now use modern card layout
  • Widget visibility moved to Widgets tab with toggle switches per card
  • Content tab renamed to Widgets

v0.3.4

  • Beta update channel — enable beta builds from the Plugin settings tab
  • Auto-updater now switches between stable and beta Gist manifests based on channel setting

v0.3.0

  • Settings page redesigned with 5 tabs: Dashboard, Content, Tracking, Developer Tools, Plugin
  • Tracking tab: GTM, Google Ads, Meta Pixel, X Pixel, Microsoft Clarity — IDs inject scripts automatically
  • Developer Tools tab: G6 Asset Manager integrated (enable/disable toggle)
  • All new settings gated to Group6 email users only

v0.1

  • Initial beta release
